notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: (5) The customer's right to prior notice of a change in the virtual currency kiosk operator's rules or policies.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects
self-report.quote: (a) Each virtual currency kiosk operator shall submit a report of the location of each virtual currency kiosk located within the State within 45 days of the end of the calendar quarter.

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_takes: (2) Under what circumstances the virtual currency kiosk operator will, absent a court or government order, disclose information concerning the customer's account to third parties.
boundary.quote_limits: - A virtual currency kiosk operator shall not release, settle, or complete any transaction subject to the 48-hour hold before the hold period expires, regardless of customer request, operator discretion, or automated system behavior.

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: (2) The virtual currency kiosk operator shall refund fees imposed by the operator if all of the following apply:
fair-exchange.quote_gets: (b) The receipt required under subsection (a) of this section shall be provided as a physical written receipt unless the customer requests to receive an electronic receipt.
